findings.description: SYS-SUP-013 starts withholding watchdog service only after both fault-report transmission and safe-state entry complete. For a detected task fault, it leaves service between detection and that point unspecified, although STK-SUP-005 permits servicing only while every supervised task is healthy. OP-SYS-011 records the unresolved conflict with completing the fault reactions before a watchdog reset.
findings.requested_change: Resolve the watchdog-service rule for the interval between fault detection and completion of both reactions, then specify the resulting obligation consistently with the approved decision.
